blocked_by_firewall.description: Requests from Home Assistant to Two Spoons were challenged by the site's firewall. Home Assistant will try again in 15 minutes; this notice clears itself once a request gets through. If it keeps happening, check the firewall rule that lets the Home Assistant API through.
